name: Nature Resistance
notes: Trainer-taught passive. 4 ranks in Classic Era: Nature resistance +30/60/90/120 (Wowhead Classic and Forever; Wowhead Forever tooltips print 'Rank 1'-'Rank 4').

Rank count: Warcraft Tavern Classic hunter-pets guide says R4 (level 50); Warcraft Tavern hunter-pet-abilities guide says R5 and tentonhammer lists a rank 5 (+140, level 60) - rank 5 is TBC data, no rank-5 spell exists on Wowhead Classic or Forever.
TP per rank (5/15/45/90) agrees between mmonster.co (Forever client data) and tentonhammer (TBC-era page); warcraft.wiki.gg gives rank 1 = 5 TP at level 20.
Classic-only unclassed 100 yd variants 24517, 24523, 24524, 24525 exist on Wowhead Classic; not trainer data as far as found.

spellIds order in wowhead observations: [petSpellId, teachSpellId]. The first ID is the pet's own spell (what the pet casts / has as a passive; Wowhead Forever categorises it as 'Generic Pet Abilities'). The second ID is the hunter-side 'teach' spell (100 yd range, Instant, 'Requires Hunter'; Wowhead Classic shows its Effect #1 as 'Learn Spell' -> pet spell, e.g. 4195 -> 4187; Wowhead Forever categorises these as 'Beast Training Abilities').

Wowhead observations were read from Wowhead's tooltip JSON endpoint (nether.wowhead.com/classic|forever/tooltip/spell/<id>); petLevel = the 'Requires level N' line of the spell named in the observation url. Wowhead does not publish training point costs on spell pages, so tp is null there.

Wowhead Classic tooltips do not print rank numbers for Growl/Great Stamina/Natural Armor/resistances; rank order is by required level and effect value. Wowhead Forever tooltips/search results do print 'Rank N' and agree with this order.
mmonster.co is a WoW Forever fan guide; it says its trainer prices are 'Client data' read during the Forever beta and 'not checked again since' (page build 70959, updated 2026-11-18).

tentonhammer.com table is a 2016 page written for TBC-era data (it lists an extra rank 11 for Great Stamina/Natural Armor and rank 5 for resistances, which do not exist in Classic). Only the ranks that exist in Classic are recorded here; treat its levels with caution.
Petopia Classic (petopia.brashendeavors.net) could not be read: TLS certificate error on fetch; web.archive.org also blocked. Wowhead Classic guide/calculator pages returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch.
